data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate held gross claims outstanding of $126.387m at the start of 2020 (1 Jan 2020). The 2018 closed underwriting year was adversely impacted by several natural catastrophes (Californian Wildfires, Hurricane Michael, Typhoon Jebi) and closed with a declared loss, while the 2020 underwriting year experienced losses from the COVID-19 pandemic and multiple hurricanes (Laura, Sally, Delta, Zeta). The report does not provide a single explicit gross prioryear reserve movement figure; reserve movements reported in the accounts combine current year activity and reinsurance effects, and the presence of reinsurance to close activity and portfolio movements prevents a clear gross PYD extraction. Primary drivers cited are natural catastrophe events and COVID-19 related claims, together with increased cyber/ransomware claims activity.
raw_causal_phrases: 2020 saw the syndicate impacted by some high frequency, medium range natural catastrophe activity, as well as Covid-19 related claims activity.

The 2018 underwriting year has closed with a declared loss of $6.7m, which represents a loss on capacity of 8.9% having been impacted by natural catastrophes including the Californian Wildfires, Hurricane Michael and Typhoon Jebi.
The 2020 underwriting year has been impacted by losses relating the COVID-19 global pandemic as well as natural catastrophes including Hurricanes Laura, Sally, Delta and Zeta.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding 2019 year-end = $126,386.6k -> 126.3866m USD). The report does not provide an explicit GROSS prior-year development (PYD) figure; movement lines in the technical provisions combine current year development and reinsurance effects and the Profit & Loss's 'claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years' is a P&L flow (not a reserve movement) and therefore was not used. A gross claims development triangle (percentages and ultimate by underwriting year) is present but contains an aggregate/older column and potential distortions from reinsurance-to-close; extraction of a definitive gross PYD from the triangle would require additional assumptions, so PYD is reported as null. All monetary amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD) and expressed in millions.
